title: Credit
description: Credit contracts, disbursements and adjustment flows (loan-service).
adjustments_hint: Pick an adjustment kind and press Reload to load its flows.
workbench_hint: Track and approve the cases in the Workbench (Workbench menu).
draft_created_hint: The record is in DRAFT — submit it through the Workbench to run the posting.

detail.description: Credit contract header and the loan formation case status.
detail.pending_hint: The contract is awaiting approval — follow the progress in the Workbench.
detail.rejected_hint: The contract was rejected — see the decision note in the Workbench, adjust and recreate the contract.

adjustment_create.title: New adjustment flow
adjustment_create.description: Create a DRAFT record for the adjustment flow; submit it from the list above.

adjustment_validation.agreement_required: This flow requires the disbursement agreement code
adjustment_validation.amount_or_percent_required: Enter the amount or the waiver percentage
adjustment_validation.payload_required: A required flow field is missing

adjustment_create_failed: Failed to create the adjustment flow

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Principal + interest receipts per agreement; submitted through the workbench — the posting is journaled automatically after approval.
collections.dialog_description: Collect principal + interest per disbursement agreement. After creation, submit it through the workbench — the posting is journaled automatically once approved.

validation.contract_required: Select a contract and enter the disbursement agreement code
validation.amounts_positive: Principal or interest must be positive

disbursements.title: Disbursements
disbursements.description: Register and complete disbursements, submit through the workbench; after approval the entry posts to the ledger automatically.
disbursements.dialog_description: Pick an ACTIVE contract and enter the disbursement amount. After creation, submit it through the workbench — the posting is journaled automatically once approved.

register.title: Register disbursement
register.dialog_description: Create the original disbursement for an ACTIVE contract. Once the row is posted (POSTED), further drawdowns can be recorded via the Complete disbursement flow.

complete.title: Complete disbursement
complete.dialog_description: Pick a posted (POSTED) register disbursement to draw against. The amount defaults to the source register amount; the backend validates the source's remaining limit.
complete.failed: Failed to create the completion disbursement

placeholder.amount: Defaults to the source register amount

complete.remainder_note: The backend rejects amounts exceeding the remaining un-completed portion of the source register (same agreement, POSTED).
complete.disabled_hint: At least one posted register disbursement is required to complete a disbursement

validation.contract_required: Select a contract and enter the amount

loan_products.title: Credit products
loan_products.description: Loan product catalog — contracts inherit limits/rates/classification from the product.
loan_products.dialog_description: Products link to a classification for finance COA postings.

validation.required: Product code and name are required

loan_vfu.title: Trust (VFU)
loan_vfu.description: Trust parties, mandate contracts and funding plans.
loan_vfu.dialog_description: Trust records back the fee-allocation and revenue-allocation flows.

dialog_description: The contract is submitted into the multi-level formation case.

validation.required: Contract code and customer are required
